description: Creates a draft Campaign. Requires contacts:write. Optional playbookId copies a workspace playbook. Does not enroll contacts or send messages. Reuse the idempotencyKey for exact retries; changed input needs a new key. Without a playbook uses the generic other stage preset, including parked stages.

goal.description: Campaign goal, e.g. learn, recruit_interviews, relationship_building, audience_growth, or a custom goal.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable UUID reused for exact retries; changed input needs a new key.

playbookId.description: Optional workspace playbook; its stages are copied. Creates a draft without enrolling or contacting anyone.

name: campaign_create
title: Create Campaign
